caption: Crafts an iron block from every nine iron ingots. A hopper fills the crafter one ingot per slot. A comparator reads the crafter; a second comparator, reading a crafter whose nine slots are all disabled, holds a constant 9 at its side, so it turns on only when all nine slots are full. Its signal goes round through two dust and a repeater into the stone beside the crafter, which then crafts into the chest below.

Crafts a crafting table from every four planks. The iron block machine with five of the crafter's slots disabled, so the planks fill the top-left 2x2 and the comparator reads 9 once four planks are in.

Crafts four sticks from every two planks. The iron block machine with seven of the crafter's slots disabled, so the planks fill the top two slots of the left column and the comparator reads 9 once two planks are in.
